protocol.timing_clock: time.perf_counter Popen.communicate with piped output through process exit; write logs outside timer
protocol.dispersion: inclusive quartiles, min/max; no timing exclusions in definitive study

pilot.reason: file-redirection subprocess.run timeout polls completion; corrected to piped communicate before definitive measurements

timer_relationships.compileInner: wraps executeActions and endToEndActions; same approximate interval in these runs
timer_relationships.SemanticChecking: direct wrapper around checkAllTranslationUnits; do not sum
timer_relationships.loadBuiltinModule: contains readSerializedModuleAST and readSerializedModuleIR; outside compileInner on fresh CLI
timer_relationships.linkAndOptimizeIR: includes specialization, simplification and other passes
timer_relationships.simplifyIR: aggregates multiple invocations, including paths called by other passes; not an exclusive stage

limitations: No GPU kernel execution or material runtime oracle.
Fresh-process residual is not isolated process startup/session overhead.
Output minus link/optimize residual is not a direct NVVM/NVRTC time.
GDB samples are qualitative wall-interrupt observations with debugger perturbation, not CPU attribution or predicted speedup.
Historical214 session-reuse evidence is inherited, not remeasured.

next_hypothesis.boundary: canonical NodeBase subtype tests in as<T>/dynamicCast<T>
next_hypothesis.observation: isSubClassOf is the most frequent leaf in each of three completed semantic-only debugger runs (19/121,22/118,22/119); same generated tag range predicate reached through metadata conversion
next_hypothesis.hypothesis: Avoid the out-of-line tag-to-SyntaxClassInfo roundtrip for NodeBase casts while reusing the existing generated firstTag/tagCount range as the sole hierarchy truth. Compare minimal inlining against direct canonical-tag predicate; do not introduce alternate hierarchy, per-material shortcuts or semantic caches.
next_hypothesis.not_yet_proven: No speedup or implementation chosen; snapshot share is not a CPU-time percentage.
next_hypothesis.prototype_gate: Exhaustive every registered source tag x every target class including abstract classes against generated hierarchy and original predicate; null pointers, const overloads, invalid/default policy, DeclRefBase cast restrictions, AST serialization and non-NVVM overload/generic/constraint diagnostics; exact six material PTX/cubin hashes; full compiler units and frozen/discovery checkpoint because shared AST casting is broad. Benchmark paired optimized before/after: at least5% SemanticChecking median reduction in each material identity, at least2% reduction in the sum of the six per-identity fresh-process medians (18 measured samples per identity), no greater than2% per-identity wall regression across both order rounds; reject if benefits not robust.
next_hypothesis.expected_metric: SemanticChecking ms primary; fresh-process ms secondary; backend phase residual and assembly should stay stable. Thresholds are future acceptance choices, not observed improvements.
